title: Auth Discoverer: HTML Form Detection and Application Fingerprint
goal: Implement a shared service that fetches a target's registration / login page, parses the HTML form structure (action URL, method, field names, hidden inputs), and emits a normalized application fingerprint suitable for use as a cache key and as input to the AI recipe builder (task #376).
scope: Create api/app/services/auth_discoverer.py with two pure functions: fetch_auth_pages(base_url, scope_allowlist) and fingerprint_application(html_documents). Reuse existing scope check helpers. No AI calls in this task. Pure HTML parsing + heuristic stack detection.
generation_reason: Empirical test on 2026-05-15 showed cookie-tamper, stored-xss, file-upload, param-pollution probes silently no-op on testasp.vulnweb.com, demo.testfire.net, juice-shop.herokuapp.com because they hardcoded Gruyere's saveprofile?action=new pattern. Form detection is the first universal building block; existing xss_proof/runner.py:_try_register_with_ai is a working reference implementation that can be extracted and generalized.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Form detection + fingerprint only. No AI calls in this task. No cache logic in this task (that is #377). No probe migration in this task (that is #378).
constraints.scope_allowlist_enforced: All HTTP requests must respect the passed scope_allowlist via web_target_value_is_allowed_with_path.

success_criteria: auth_discoverer.fetch_auth_pages probes common register/login paths and returns observed HTML documents for those that respond 200.

auth_discoverer.fingerprint_application parses HTML forms and returns a normalized dict: { stack_hints, register_form: { action, method, fields }, login_form: { action, method, fields }, session_cookie_hint }.
Fingerprint is deterministic for identical inputs (same HTML => same fingerprint).
Fingerprint correctly distinguishes Gruyere / juice-shop / demo.testfire.net / testasp.vulnweb.com on test fixtures.
Unit tests cover at least 4 distinct stacks with fixture HTML.

acceptance_criteria: Fingerprint output is JSON-serializable, under 2 KB per target.
Module performs no live HTTP during unit tests (uses fixtures).
No Gruyere-specific identifiers hardcoded in production code (only in test fixtures).

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
backlog-374 checkpoint must show go for Phase 2.

out_of_scope: OAuth, SAML, or any non-form auth flow.
